request_state.context: BCDY 2015 Prop 16 uses the same mechanism as our C047 chain (parametrisation (7) + Bennett-Skinner Thm 1.1) for (2,2n,3) and Theorem 2 gives (2m,2n,3) for n = 3 mod 4, m>=2. Our chain: (2m,2n,3) for ALL m,n>=4, by observing 3 divides at most one of s,t so the delta=0 branch is available on at least one side. Neither BCDY Table 1 nor the 2024 survey lists (2m,2n,3) with m,n>=4 unconditionally.

status.instructions: What is the honest status of the C047 chain relative to the literature?

criteria.known: an unstated but obvious corollary of BCDY; treat as folklore, not novel
criteria.new_stmt: a new stated theorem whose proof is a two-line corollary of published tools
criteria.subsumed: already stated somewhere in BCDY or later work

worth_lean.instructions: Is it worth formalising the elementary part of the chain in Lean now?
